evidence: Carries the 'Build system' label and modifies CMakeLists.txt and cmake/secp256k1.cmake to manage compiler flags passed to secp256k1.
rationale: Fixes a regression where secp256k1 objects omit hardening flags, causing linkers to drop binary-wide hardware control-flow protections (like AArch64 BTI/PAC/GCS or x86_64 CET) from bitcoind. As the author notes, 'the unhardened secp256k1 objects cause the final executable to lose hardware control-flow protections' on master.
